frozen: 2026-09-26, before any Bournemouth frame was seen. Every value is the one docs/CINE_DEMO_BUILD_PLAN_2026-09-26.md section 1b states; tuning, if any, happens on the synthetic cine only and is committed before the Bournemouth frames are inferred.

notes.association: cost = 1 - IoU(track box shifted by its velocity, detection box); admissible if IoU >= iou_gate or centre distance <= centre_gate_x_median_det_height x the frame's median detection height, and cost <= max_cost; scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment. With these values cost <= 0.9 is IoU >= 0.1, so the centre-distance alternative never admits a pair on its own: it would only matter if max_cost were raised.
notes.update: box and corners replaced by the detection; velocity = alpha x observed displacement per frame + (1 - alpha) x velocity; logp = lambda x logp + log(posterior + eps) over meta.level_order
notes.birth_death: every unmatched detection starts a tentative track; confirmed after min_consecutive_hits consecutive hits; a tentative track that misses is dropped; a confirmed track dies after round(max_age_s x fps) consecutive misses (5 frames at 15 fps, 3 at 10.3 fps)
notes.naming: every confirmed track (detected, or coasting and not overlapping a detected one by coast_dedupe_iou) sorted by y; softmax(logp) decoded by fluorocap_anchor.decode(probs, set(), {}, None, direction_known, w_rare); abstain when the decoded name differs from the pooled argmax or its pooled probability is below abstain_below
